name: Command Aliases
description:
Create your own short commands, hotkeys and automations from an in-game menu, so you never have to type long commands again. Open the menu with the K key (you can rebind it in Controls) or by typing /aliases.

PROFILES: Pick a profile first (with its own picture from the game, like a grass block or a diamond). Only one profile is on at a time, and each one keeps its own commands, hotkeys and automations. The menu remembers where you were until you leave the world.

QUICK COMMANDS: Turn any command into a shortcut. For example, make /s run /gamemode survival @s. Start a shortcut with / to type it as a command, or with ! or ? to type it in chat (like !s or ?s). Shortcuts are not case sensitive. Extra words you type are added to the end, or placed exactly where you write {args}. Use the chain builder to run several commands in a row, with a wait of 0 to 5 seconds between them.

HOTKEYS: Pick any key (or a combo like Ctrl+H) and choose what it runs when you press it in game.

AUTOMATIONS: Run commands by themselves when you join a world or server, when you die, or when you respawn.

Every item can be switched ON or OFF, edited, removed, or dragged up and down into any order. Everything saves automatically and stays until you remove it. Client-side only, so it works on any server without the server needing the mod.
